So the error was in the final step, step 5, where the Planner incorrectly normalized the developer to the parent company instead of just stating Crystal Dynamics.

So the mistake was made by the Planner at step 5, where they conflated the developer (Crystal Dynamics) with the parent company (Square Enix), leading to an incorrect final answer.
